svg.title: The data flow of a search
svg.desc: A user searches for invoice. The unified search passes the term, the cursor, the limit and the user to the search provider. Without a term, an archive account or a connection, the provider answers with no results and doesn't ask Paperless. Otherwise, until the page of results is full, the Paperless client asks Paperless-ngx with the token for the page of 25 hits that holds the next hit, and only for the fields that a result shows, and Paperless answers with the ID, the title, the date and the excerpt of documents 412, 389, 371 and more, and whether a next page exists. One call of the file locator covers all documents of that page and returns for each a file of the archive account with its marker, or none. This repeats for at most 4 pages of Paperless or 3 seconds. The provider answers with an entry for every document with a file, up to the limit, and the cursor of the first hit that it didn't go through.
